# Ashiwani Kumar - Linux DevOps Engineer & DevOps Practitioner

> Personal portfolio and professional profile of Ashiwani Kumar, a Linux DevOps Engineer with 7+ years of experience managing mission-critical infrastructure across UAE.

## About

Ashiwani Kumar is a Linux DevOps Engineer based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, currently working at Astek Middle East. He specializes in managing mission-critical infrastructure for aviation systems serving 50M+ passengers annually across 5 UAE airports, achieving 99.9% uptime.

## Core Expertise

- Linux DevOps Engineering (SRE)
- Kubernetes & OpenShift orchestration
- AWS Cloud Infrastructure
- Terraform Infrastructure as Code
- Ansible Automation
- CI/CD Pipeline Design (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
- DevSecOps practices
- Linux Administration
- Docker containerization
- Monitoring & Observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
